title: Starving to the point of famine
text: “Still here—”
Luna-chan’s eyes rolled over toward us with a sharp glint. This is a mortal crisis, I say! Filo-tan! Stop it, I beg of you!
“T-This is bad… let’s run for it, quickly! There’s no telling what happens if we get caught!”
“Wait right there!” she seemed to shout as she started moving, and Itsuki and I broke into a full sprint away from the scene.
“Motoyasu-san!”
Itsuki hopped onto my back. Hey, get off, I say! We’ll never outrun her like this!
“Let’s put some distance between us with Drive Mode! Otherwise she’ll catch up!”
“R-Right, understood! Drive Mode it is!”
I hastily shifted into Drive Mode and bolted away from the rapidly pursuing Luna-chan, weaving through the shadows of buildings in a full-blown chase.
“Wait right there! You adorable little creatures! Luna wants to dote on you!”
“Luna! Let go of me, damn it!”
“What’s all this racket?”
That was when Black Thunder showed up, having heard the commotion.
“Kuro! Perfect timing, help me out! I know I look like this, but it’s me! Ren!”
“Hmm… tch, normie scum.”
Black Thunder spat that out at Ren, who was currently captured in Luna-chan’s grip, and then simply turned his back and walked away.
“Wha—Kuro! Hey! How is this ‘normie’ in any way?! Look more carefully! This isn’t Naofumi, you idiot!”
“Ufufu… so cute~”

After searching around for us for a good while, Luna-chan eventually wandered off somewhere with Ren in tow. We managed to slip past her watchful eyes and, using our concealment skills, finally made our escape.
“She’s gone now…”
“Somehow we managed to weather that storm.”
“Still… for Ren-san to be so adored by Luna-san of all people… Kurotarou-san has been troubled by being a male Filolial, so perhaps this could turn into a wonderful bond.”

Hmm… it’s true, for Luna-chan as she is now, Ren might just be the ideal match. Her unrequited love was always for Keel, whom she cherished above all else, but Ren is male, after all. For a man drowning in loneliness like him, this might be a perfect fit. In any case, Luna-chan in her current state is far too terrifying for me to approach. Ren, be a proper sacrifice and soothe Luna-chan’s heart, I say! Rafumi was just watching the whole thing unfold too, mind you.
“Fweeeh…”
“Rishia-san, you really saved us.”
“A-Are you really sure it’s okay for this to be you, Itsuki-kun?”
Right now, we were watching Luna-chan retreat from the window of Riska’s room in Itsuki’s house.
“Does this prove it to you?”
Itsuki transformed his bow into a gun and fired off an entire clip at lightning speed, striking every target on the shelf.
“That rapid-fire shooting is certainly Itsuki-kun’s doing. But that appearance…”
“I was practicing animal transformation magic, and somehow I ended up like this and can’t change back. Rishia-san, Rafuemon-san, do either of you have any idea what might have caused it?”
“I-I don’t know anything about it!”
“I have no clue either.”
“I see…”
Honestly, Itsuki really went and did something troublesome, I say.
“The suspicious part is the equipment used as a catalyst. Let’s start investigating from there~kyu.”
“I’ll help too.”
“That would be a huge help. Though… what on earth is even happening here. Naofumi-san and Ren-san have both been carried off by people we thought were our allies.”
“Older Sister aside, it seems Luna-chan found it to be quite the toxic substance… truly terrifying, I say.”

Thinking back on it, Luna-chan is a Filolial-sama who adores cute creatures above all else, and Keel, whom she treasures most, doesn’t exist in this particular loop. In other words, she’s been in a state of pure starvation, though for her that’s simply become the norm. And into that void appeared Ren, looking remarkably similar to Keel—the single most potent “toxic substance” we know of across all the loops so far. It’s safe to assume the substitute moles simply weren’t enough to satisfy her anymore. That aura she was giving off truly was terrifying.
“What’s going to happen to Naofumi-san and Ren-san…”
“Ren will probably be treated the same as Keel, so at least he won’t get eaten. More worrying is Father, honestly.”
Just then, Father came trotting through the village along with Big Sister and a Raph-species.
“Ah, Naofumi-saaan.”
“Father, over here! Oi!”
“That voice belongs to Itsuki and Motoyasu-kun.”
Father noticed our voices and came over to us, so we ducked into the house to take shelter.
“Naofumi-san, you were carried off by Sadeena-san, but it looks like things worked out somehow?”

“Hmm… I’m not sure ‘worked out’ is the right phrase, more like ‘someone worked it out for me.’ Sadeena-san kept saying ‘oh my, oh my’ over and over while stroking me all over, the whole time I was trying to explain things to her. She was investigating, sure, but she was really petting me a lot.”
Father answered, looking troubled, saying she did seem to be listening, but she also seemed thoroughly absorbed in petting him.
“I recall Father from a different loop petting Big Sister in just that same manner, I say.”
“Birds of a feather, married or not. How passionate… I suppose we can conclude that Sadeena-san simply loses all reason the moment Naofumi-san turns into a Peckle?”

“Who knows? Anyway, since it seemed unwise to leave things solely to Sadeena-san, Raphtalia-chan and the others brought out some strong liquor to distract her somehow… and I slipped away in the confusion.”
Oh… so Big Sister had also noticed that Older Sister was behaving strangely.
“Raphtalia-chan, thank you.”
“Y-Yes.”
Father was thanking Big Sister, I say.
“Raph.”
The Raph-species clung to Father’s back.
“In a situation like this, Gaelion-chan would probably be reliable, but is she over at Wyndia-chan’s place? Or maybe with Imiya-chan?”
“Imiya-san was being harassed by Luna-san, though…”
“Come to think of it, where’s Ren…”
“Ah, Ren-san was attacked by Luna-san and carried off.”
“Is that going to be okay?”
“I imagine he’s currently being doted on just like you were.”
“He won’t die, but it’ll be rough on him. It’s a relief that Itsuki has Rishia-san and Rafuemon keeping their wits about them.”
“You never know what turns out to be a blessing in disguise. In any case, I think it’d be best to call Gaelion-san over.”
“I’ll go get her.”

Rafuemon left the house as is and headed toward the monster stables where Assistant was. Ngh… it galls me greatly to admit, but Rival does know a lot about magic. Perhaps she really can be of some help, I say.
“I’ll go check on the catalyst~kyu.”
Riska likewise headed off toward the room where we’d been using magic.
“Ugh… what the hell is Sadeena’s deal. And here I was busy looking after the babies…”
At that moment, Panda came stomping along, leading a group of babies.
“Oh, it’s Lars-san. Hey, over here!”
Father stepped out of the house and called out to Panda.
“Raph~?”
The Raph-species climbed down off Father’s back and tilted its head curiously.
“Naofumi-san! That’s far too careless of you!”
“Ah? Wh-what is this—”
Father went right up to Panda and jumped up and down, waving his arms as if to announce his presence.
“Lars-san. You might be surprised, but hear me out—I messed up a transformation spell and ended up like this, and I’m looking for a way to undo it. Do you have any idea, Lars-san?”
Panda scooped Father right up in her arms.
“Kyakya!”

Then, after glancing around warily, she simply walked off carrying both Father and the babies together. That gesture… it’s exactly the same one Father and Older Sister make whenever they find a creature they’ve taken a liking to, I say.
